caption: One request drawn with the worked example's own numbers: a user at 2 ETH and nonce 7 ends at 1.699 ETH and nonce 8, while the contract gains 0.3 ETH. The wallet only signs; the node and the world state it holds decide every number, and the 0.001 ETH fee never reaches the contract.

spec.title: One request: 0.3 ETH from nonce 7
spec.aria: A user holding 2 ETH with nonce 7 asks a wallet to send 0.3 ETH; the wallet signs it, an Ethereum node checks nonce and balance, peer nodes execute the block, and the world state ends with the user at 1.699 ETH and nonce 8 and the contract credited with 0.3 ETH.
